title: It's Ready! (Delivery & Care Tips)

expressions.expr: Your display is ready to pick up
expressions.meaning: Seu monitor está pronto para retirar
expressions.example: Good news, Carlos! Your display is ready to pick up.

expressions.expr: It looks as good as new
expressions.example: Wow, the map is back! It looks as good as new.

expressions.expr: Store it out of the sunlight
expressions.meaning: Guarde longe da luz do sol
expressions.example: One tip: keep it dry and store it out of the sunlight.

expressions.expr: How much do I owe you?
expressions.example: Everything is working perfectly. How much do I owe you?

sentences: Good news: your display is ready to pick up.
We have replaced the loose cable.
We have tightened the antenna connection.
We have also installed a firmware update.
It looks as good as new.
Clean the screen gently and store it out of the sunlight.
How much do I owe you?

grammar.title: Present Perfect na entrega: We've replaced / We've tested
rules: Para mostrar o resultado pronto do conserto, use We've (We have) + particípio: "We've replaced the cable."
Outros exemplos de bancada: "We've tightened the connection." / "We've cleaned the screen." / "We've tested everything."
Se você disser QUANDO fez (yesterday, on Monday), volte para o Passado Simples: "We installed the update yesterday."
Para dar dicas de conservação na entrega, use o verbo base: "Keep it dry." / "Store it out of the sunlight."
